import aperture
import hashlib

text = aperture.read_text('response.txt')
words = text.split()
report = {'characters': len(text), 'words': len(words), 'lines': len(text.splitlines()), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(text.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()}
aperture.write_json('analysis.json', report)
print('Verified text statistics:', report)
